content: ydotool requires ydotoold daemon; default socket perms too restrictive (root-only 600, bugzilla 2250692; issues #73 #198 #207): fix via dedicated group (e.g. input/ydotool) + UMask=0077 on the systemd unit + YDOTOOL_SOCKET env var pointing at the socket path; NixOS/Arch/Fedora threads all converge on group+UMask. Ubuntu 24.04 ships ydotool with its own unit conventions - e2e stand must provision ydotoold, document socket path, and verify group membership; uinput device node access also required.
